name: Card
description: Surface primitive for a discrete, self-contained item, not ordinary page sections. Default 16px padding, 12px surface radius, no border or shadow. Native link/button hosts support single interactions; keep mixed actions inside a static Card. Child overflow remains visible; crop media separately.

testing.rationale: Storybook verifies button activation, independent actions with progress/completion feedback and repeated-activation prevention inside static cards, and narrow two-column geometry. Browser tests cover surface feedback, disabled states including interactive=false, native keyboard behavior, empty-href link inference, form submission, theme-aware focus, responsive link geometry, unclipped SM/MD text/link/icon hit areas at all padding levels, media cropping, margin/float containment, keyboard scrolling of wide content, coarse pointers, and reduced motion.

as.description: Polymorphic element. Use 'a' with href for link cards, 'button' for button cards.

padding.description: Inner padding: none=0, sm=12px, md=16px (default), lg=24px. Use none for edge-to-edge media with composite-owned content spacing; keep peer cards consistent. No automatic breakpoint changes.

bordered.description: Opt-in hairline border. Only for dense listing grids — use sparingly (rule card-no-border default).

interactive.description: Adds hover/press styling and a 44px minimum target. Inferred for as='button' or as='a' with href, including an empty href. Does not add semantics or keyboard handlers to custom hosts. Focus-visible and disabled styling remain available when false.

href.description: Native link destination; requires as='a'. Does not automatically select an anchor host.

type.description: Native type for as='button'. Defaults to button to avoid implicit form submission.

disabled.description: Native disabled state for as='button'. Stops activation and hover/press feedback while preserving the selected surface.

border.note: Default border: none. `bordered` only in dense grids.

radii.note: Base Card uses --radius-surface-default (12px). ProductCard owns its geometry via --radius-component-default (8px); do not use arbitrary numeric overrides.

elevationOnPress.note: Enabled interactive cards mix the surface's reading color into the background on hover (8%) and press (16%), preserving polarity and geometry without shadow.

focus.note: Focusable cards show a 2px --focus-ring outline with 2px offset. The outer outline follows the surrounding canvas theme, including when the card itself uses an inverse surface.

accessibility.role: none (div); native button or link when as selects those hosts
accessibility.notes: The 44px minimum applies only with interactive styling. Static divs have no implicit group role or tab stop. Buttons support Enter/Space and native disabled; links support Enter. Custom hosts own semantics and activation, including aria-disabled behavior. Focusable hosts retain a theme-aware focus outline even when interactive=false; disabled text and cursor styling also remain available.
